TulsaConnect DC3 is a facility in Tulsa County, Oklahoma with an address at 4500 S 129th E Ave that has been matched to a datacentermap listing and the operator's own contact page. No power capacity, square footage, or IT load is published for this campus. Without published specifications, its scale relative to AI infrastructure cannot be determined.

Oklahoma has nine mapped data center facilities on record, and none publish power capacity figures. TulsaConnect DC3 is therefore ranked first by published megawatts in the state, a distinction that reflects the absence of published data across all Oklahoma facilities rather than any confirmed capacity advantage.

The operator describes itself as Oklahoma's oldest locally owned data center provider dating to 1996, but whether this facility is configured for high-density compute workloads, what certifications it holds, or what power and cooling it can deliver to tenants are not published.
